final_candidates.decision_summary: S159 lies in the Sa antigenic site on the HA head (WT verified: residue 159 is S). S159N is a recurring immune-escape substitution in H1 and is structurally tolerated, likely preserving folding and replication fitness.

N163 (WT verified: N at 163) is a surface-exposed Sa-site residue where substitutions alter antibody binding. N163K is a conservative-length charge change expected to preserve fold while reducing antibody recognition.

K185 (WT verified: K at 185) sits in the Ca2 antigenic region. A charge reversal is often tolerated at exposed head positions and can disrupt antibody contact while retaining receptor-binding-site integrity.

stop_reason.detail: Round and tool budget exhausted; final Top-3 selected after WT-residue verification.

history.rationale: Asn 184 sits in the antigenic Sa/Sb boundary region (WT N verified); conservative polarity-preserving substitution may shift epitope surface without affecting the hydrophobic core.
